title: AI Age
purpose: Enter—not finish—the endgame by creating an industrial AI core from all major research eras.
optimization_opportunities: A mature pre-AI factory turns AI entry into coordination rather than a new raw-material grind.
infrastructure_reuse: Every prior production site and transport route becomes a managed node in the digital industrial network.

milestones.title: Civilization Capability Audit
final_validation: Confirm Orbital and Lunar archives, Quantum completion, Martian Autonomy, and Lite Matter completion.

milestones.title: Artificial Industrial Intelligence Core
final_validation: Demonstrate the capability: Artificial Industrial Intelligence Core.
milestones.temporary_validation: Obtain the test AI Core. Final validation requires the five canonical research/capability inputs and future AI-core manufacturing.

milestones.title: Enter the AI Age
final_validation: Enter the continuously expanding endgame and authorize AI-coordinated digital industry.

milestones.title: Applied Energistics Entry
final_validation: In testing-placeholder mode, use the AI-gated recipes to bring a basic AE2 network online. With placeholders disabled, AE2 remains locked pending the final AI Core.
milestones.temporary_validation: The AI Core is consumed by every temporary AE2 entry recipe; recipes do not exist when testing placeholders are disabled.
